page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. This instance features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a total of 96 vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance runs on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Because the instance allocates dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, it delivers predictable compute performance for workloads requiring sustained CPU utilization. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density compute resource, offering a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:4 alongside high-frequency processing capabilities. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local storage, requiring external block storage solutions, and the lack of hardware-accelerated GPU resources.

This hardware profile is suited for compute-intensive workloads, high-performance web serving, application servers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated physical CPU cores without hyperthreading.
